name: gmail-inbox-agent
description: Triages, summarizes, and drafts replies for a Gmail inbox by calling a Gmail MCP server.

model.notes: Model-agnostic by design — swap providers without touching the tool wiring below.

gmail.description: Connects to the user's Gmail account. Requires an OAuth-authorized Gmail MCP server (see SKILL.md).

permissions.notes: Sending is disabled by default — the agent drafts replies for a human to review and send.
